checkout.event: The payment gateway charges the card but the response is lost and the client retries
checkout.required_outcome: the order is charged exactly once

checkout.event: The payment gateway returns a 500 error
checkout.required_outcome: the charge is retried and the client gets a defined result
the client receives a decline response and no payment is recorded

jobs.event: A worker process crashes while running a job
jobs.required_outcome: the job is not lost and is processed again

jobs.event: A job raises an error while running
jobs.required_outcome: the job is retried with a defined delay and limit

jobs.event: A producer sends the same job twice

auth.event: A user changes their password while signed in on another device
auth.required_outcome: the other device's access is handled

auth.event: A refresh token is used again after it was already exchanged
auth.required_outcome: the old token is not accepted
the session can no longer be refreshed

upload.event: The client loses its connection halfway through an upload and never returns
A client tries to upload a file larger than 2 GB
upload.required_outcome: the upload is refused with a defined response

upload.event: The client uploads a single part successfully
upload.required_outcome: the client can check the part's integrity

notifications.event: The push provider is down for an hour
A user reaches the hourly notification limit
notifications.required_outcome: further notifications are handled by a defined rule

notifications.event: A notification is created at 23:30 in the user's local time

cart.event: A shopper leaves without paying and never returns
cart.required_outcome: the held stock is not stuck forever

cart.event: The price of an item changes while it is in a cart
cart.required_outcome: the customer sees and is told about the new price

cart.event: A customer adds an item that has no units left
cart.required_outcome: the customer gets a defined refusal

webhooks.event: The subscriber's server stays offline for two days
A subscriber wants to confirm an event is genuine
webhooks.required_outcome: the subscriber has a way to verify the sender

webhooks.event: Two events for the same order are created one after the other
webhooks.required_outcome: the subscriber receives them in a defined order

cache.event: A user edits their display name and reloads the page right away
cache.required_outcome: the page shows the new name

cache.event: The cache is full and a new profile must be stored

cache.required_outcome: the state of the cache is defined

export.event: The background job crashes halfway through building a large export
export.required_outcome: the client is told and can try again

export.event: A client asks for a two-year date range
export.required_outcome: the request is refused with a defined response

export.event: A client asks for the file before it is built
export.required_outcome: the client learns the file is not ready
